payload.note: Normalized additive Ward-frame checkpoint: with pi_x=exp(-psi_x)/sum_y exp(-psi_y), the bounded field X_a=P_H(a*pi) has exact divergence -sum a*pi*(1-pi) and action pairing sum pi*(r*Delta a-a*r^2). Integration by parts under the actual normalized BT Gibbs measure gives a full Stein identity. For a=1 this proves E[sum pi*r^2]=lambda^2 E[1-sum pi^2]<=lambda^2(1-1/N), improving the earlier ratio of size-biased expectations to a normalized volume-uniform estimate. The complete lowest cosine-sine frame has random diffusion matrix G_ij=sum pi*h_i*h_j, trace one, eigenvalues (1+|z_2|)/2 and (1-|z_2|)/2, mean I/2, and exact source normalization E[F_j Y_i]=delta_ij/2. This does not yet bound the field or H^-1 moment. The active gate is a BT-specific bound on reciprocal-probability second-harmonic localization together with coercivity of the conjugate score, or an actual normalized divergence sequence.
